title: `accelerate test` fails with `'Namespace' object has no attribute 'use_cpu'`
author: PaulKovalov

comments.author: muellerzr
comments.body:
Hi @PaulKovalov, could you try again installing from github? i.e.:

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/huggingface/accelerate
```

And potentially also could you copy the entire contents of your `default_config.yaml` file as well?

comments.author: strasserpatrick
comments.body:

```yaml

compute_environment: AMAZON_SAGEMAKER
distributed_type: 'NO'
dynamo_backend: 'NO'
ec2_instance_type: ml.t3.2xlarge

region: eu-central-1
sagemaker_inputs_file: null

use_cpu: false
```
